mentions.name: AssetRoom
mentions.description: This platform sends AI summaries of SEC filings to help users discover interesting companies. It also runs a weekly stock poll in which a stock is picked, key facts are presented, and the community votes and discusses whether it is overvalued or a hidden gem.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a quicker way to discover interesting companies and hear what others think about them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I run AssetRoom, which sends AI summaries of SEC filings. Found myself wanting a quicker way to discover interesting companies and hear what others think about them.

So I added a weekly poll. I pick a stock, show some key facts, and let people vote and discuss whether it’s overvalued or a hidden gem.
